title: Construction of Partial Join Graphs with Perfect State Transfer in Shunt Decomposition-Based Quantum Walks
summary: In this paper, we define directed partial join graphs with signed couplings and construct discrete-time quantum-walk transition operators for these graphs using the shunt-decomposition framework. The resulting transition operators apply to several important graph families, including complete graphs with loops, circulant partial joins, complete bipartite graphs, tensor powers of complete bipartite graphs, all with signed couplings.
